header.title: GPU Passthrough
header.description: Reference for inspecting and configuring GPU / TPU passthrough on Proxmox: device identification (lspci), VFIO module setup, IOMMU validation, initramfs / GRUB updates and per-VM passthrough config (qm set hostpci, machine q35, bios ovmf).

intro.title: IOMMU must be enabled in BIOS / UEFI
intro.body: Enable IOMMU in firmware first: look for VT-d, AMD-Vi or IOMMU in BIOS/UEFI. AMD enables IOMMU by default on the Linux side, as do Intel systems with Proxmox kernels 6.8 and newer. Older Intel kernels may need intel_iommu=on. The optional iommu=pt setting controls IOMMU passthrough mode; it is not a reason to disable the host framebuffer indiscriminately.

afterChangesTip.title: After changing GRUB or modprobe configs
afterChangesTip.bodyRich: On hosts using GRUB, apply boot-option changes with update-grub. Refresh module changes with update-initramfs -u -k all, then reboot. Other bootloaders require their own configuration procedure. Verify with cat /proc/cmdline (kernel parameters), dmesg | grep -i iommu (IOMMU initialised) and find /sys/kernel/iommu_groups/ -type l | sort -V (groups present).
